caption:
Triple Net (NNN) leases shift many property operating costs to tenants, creating a cleaner cash flow profile for investors, landlords, and building owners in Chester County and Montgomery County. For business owners, NNN terms can offer lower base rent but require careful budgeting for taxes, insurance, and maintenance. Before signing or selling an NNN asset, review lease language for expense definitions, caps, escalation clauses, and responsibility for capital projects. Local factors like winter maintenance and municipal assessments can influence net outcomes here. Use a local lease checklist and plan for capital reserves to protect property value. For a practical checklist, sample lease clauses, and local guidance tailored to Chester and Montgomery County deals, visit dmsellscre.com/investors or message us for a personalized review.
